component.name: DegenView
component.summary: Market dashboard with a local Pine Script engine

description.p: DegenView watches crypto, stocks, prediction markets and CoinMarketCap indices in customizable, linked charts.
Its headline feature is a Pine Script v6 engine that runs on your own machine: write TradingView-style indicators and strategies and keep every line of source on your device.

ul.li: Crypto from Binance, Coinbase, CoinGecko and DEX pairs, US stocks through Alpaca
Polymarket and Kalshi events charted as probabilities
Drawing tools, price alerts with webhooks, and portfolio tracking
An optional local MCP server so AI assistants can inspect and drive the app

screenshot.caption: Four linked candlestick charts with indicators and a watchlist
